definitions.gloss: battledore; wooden paddle used for hanetsuki
definitions.explanation: A wooden paddle used in the traditional New Year game hanetsuki (similar to badminton without a net). Also refers to elaborately decorated paddles sold as good-luck ornaments.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{正月|しょうがつ}→お正月：05586_oshougatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{羽子板|はごいた}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{遊|あそ}んだ→遊ぶ：00550_asobu⟧。
examples.english: We played with battledore paddles at New Year's.

examples.japanese: {浅草寺|せんそうじ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{羽子板|はごいた}⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The battledore fair at Sensoji Temple is held every December.

examples.japanese: ⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{初正月|はつしょうがつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{羽子板|はごいた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{贈|おく}る→贈る：09862_okuru⟧⟦{風習|ふうしゅう}→風習：05826_fuushuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a custom of giving a battledore paddle when a baby girl is born, for her first New Year.

notes:
USAGE:
Decorated {羽子板|はごいた} are sold at year-end markets, most famously at the {浅草寺|せんそうじ}{羽子板|はごいた}⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧ (Sensoji Battledore Fair) in December. These ornamental paddles feature elaborate designs, often depicting kabuki actors, and are displayed as good-luck charms rather than used for play.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {羽子板|はごいた}⟦{市|いち}→市：10013_ichi⟧ (battledore fair)
- ⟦{飾|かざ}り→飾り：02539_kazari⟧{羽子板|はごいた} (decorative battledore)
- ⟦{羽根|はね}つき→羽根つき：07129_hanetsuki⟧ (hanetsuki — the game played with a battledore)
